title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.26730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models offer broad capabilities, but adapting them to evolving domains, tools, and requirements often entails repeated post-training. Autonomous systems automate parts of this process by proposing updates, training candidates, and using evaluation feedback to select subsequent proposals. As evidence accumulates, a central problem emerges: which past update evidence remains actionable after subsequent training has changed the parent model? An update's effect depends on its parent, data, and training stage. Treating past success as context-free permission can waste compute. If the resulting child is promoted, it can also degrade the subsequent training trajectory. translated_title: 知道何时不重用：自主大语言模型后训练中的条件经验迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26730v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型提供了广泛的能力，但将其适应于不断变化的领域、工具和需求通常需要重复的后训练。自主系统通过提出更新、训练候选模型并使用评估反馈来选择后续提议来自动化此过程的一部分。随着证据的积累，一个核心问题浮现：在后续训练改变了父模型之后，哪些过去的更新证据仍然可行？一个更新的效果取决于其父模型、数据和训练阶段。将过去的成功视为无上下文的许可可能会浪费计算资源。如果生成的子模型被提升，它还可能恶化后续的训练轨迹。我们将此问题表述为条件经验迁移，并引入了边界校准干预迁移（BCIT），一种在权重改变训练之前授权经验重用的方法。BCIT将观察到的效果绑定到其来源上下文，并检查适用性。
tldr: 本文提出BCIT方法，通过在权重改变训练前绑定经验效果与来源上下文，解决自主大语言模型后训练中何时重用过去更新证据的问题，避免计算浪费和训练轨迹恶化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BCIT, a method that binds observed effects to source contexts before weight-changing training to determine when past update evidence is reusable in autonomous LLM post-training, preventing compute waste and trajectory degradation.
